title: The ledger attributes lane sessions so cost per unattended task is computable
body:
Why: Fable plan 1114e (.krn/runs/overnight/fable-plan-1114e.md) slice 11: krn ledger --limit 20 reports workerInput: unknown (n=0), judgeInput unknown.
Outcome: lane session transcripts (krn lane run / krn-lane subagents) are attributed to their PR and task; workerInput n>0.
Proof: ledger test on captured lane transcripts; krn ledger --limit 20 shows workerInput n>0.
